report:
Abdominal wall mass, excision

Received in formalin is an ill-defined piece of fibrofatty tissue labelled abdominal wall mass, measuring 5 x 4 x 3 cm. The cut surface is whorled and tan-white. No capsule is identified. Representative sections in 4 blocks.

(1-4) Lesion with capsule, representative sections.

Sections show an infiltrative proliferation of uniform, bland spindle cells arranged in long sweeping fascicles in a collagenous stroma with thin-walled vessels, extending between skeletal muscle fibres and fat at the periphery. There is no significant cytological atypia. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells show nuclear beta-catenin expression. The findings are in keeping with desmoid-type fibromatosis. The lesion is located within skeletal muscle and reaches the inked margin.

SOFT TISSUE, abdominal wall mass, excision - DESMOID-TYPE FIBROMATOSIS; lesion reaches the inked margin
